description: The raw analytics site token for one product — the data-site value inside the krawlup analytics tag. The token is not a secret (it travels in the tagged page source by design) and is already embedded inside the snippet returned by get_analytics_snippet — never ask the founder to paste the token. Use this for hand-written tags, the @krawlup/analytics-tag npm package, or custom integrations
name: get_analytics_token
